finalText:
Build clean, exit 0.

Two real bugs, bump exposed:
- `src/core/options.js`: new bundler pass `{ retryCount }`, code still read `options.retries` (undefined) → crash on `.toFixed`. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js`: new config loader leave unset flag `undefined` instead of `false`. Strict check threw on that. Added `undefined` case → treat as disabled.

Rest of warnings (DEP0142/198/233/250/267, W1042/2213/3307) — real deprecation/lint noise from bump, not build-breaking. Left as-is; say word if you want those cleaned too.
